interaction_nodes.summary: Searches target player's library for up to three cards with flashback and puts them into that player's graveyard.
interaction_nodes.text: Search target player's library for up to three cards with flashback and put them into that player's graveyard. Then the player shuffles.

interaction_nodes.name: Intuition
interaction_nodes.summary: Search your library for three cards, reveal them, and put one into your hand while the rest go to the graveyard.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for three cards and reveal them. Target opponent chooses one. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Then shuffle.

interaction_nodes.name: Gifts Ungiven
interaction_nodes.summary: Searches your library for up to four cards with different names, reveals them, and allows an opponent to choose two to be put into your graveyard while the rest go into your hand.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for up to four cards with different names and reveal them. Target opponent chooses two of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.

interaction_nodes.name: Mystic Retrieval
interaction_nodes.summary: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand, with flashback to do the same.
interaction_nodes.text:
Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Flashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

interaction_nodes.name: Past in Flames
interaction_nodes.summary: Enables casting instants and sorceries from the graveyard until end of turn.
interaction_nodes.text:
Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
Flashback {4}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

interaction_nodes.name: Underworld Breach
interaction_nodes.summary: Enables casting nonland cards from your graveyard with escape, which requires exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
interaction_nodes.text:
Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast cards from your graveyard for their escape cost.)
At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this enchantment.

interaction_nodes.name: Training Center
interaction_nodes.summary: This land enters tapped unless you have two or more opponents, and it produces {U} or {R} when tapped.
interaction_nodes.text:
This land enters tapped unless you have two or more opponents.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}.

interaction_nodes.name: Command Tower
interaction_nodes.summary: Taps to add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.
interaction_nodes.text: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.

interaction_nodes.name: Frostboil Snarl
interaction_nodes.summary: Frostboil Snarl enters untapped if you reveal an Island or Mountain card from your hand, otherwise it enters tapped; it produces {U} or {R} when tapped.
interaction_nodes.text:
As this land enters, you may reveal an Island or Mountain card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}.

interaction_nodes.name: Island
interaction_nodes.summary: Taps to add one blue mana.

interaction_nodes.name: Mountain
interaction_nodes.summary: Tapping Mountain adds one red mana.

interaction_nodes.name: Shivan Reef
interaction_nodes.summary: Shivan Reef can tap for colorless mana or for either blue or red mana, dealing 1 damage to you when you tap it for colored mana.
interaction_nodes.text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}. This land deals 1 damage to you.

interaction_nodes.name: Brain Freeze
interaction_nodes.summary: Target player mills three cards, and copies itself for each spell cast before it this turn.
interaction_nodes.text:
